I'm currently a **Research Professional at the [IMAGINA Research Center](https://imagina.uniandes.edu.co/), Universidad de los Andes**, where I support applied research on **childhood, health, and violence prevention**, from managing and analyzing data to preparing results for policy audiences.

Beyond research, I've been a **Teaching Assistant** in Economic Analysis of Public Policy (M.A. level) for four semesters, and I've led **technical workshops** with government teams and civil society organizations. I document my work carefully so that other teams can reuse it and so that the evidence can inform policy decisions.

## Experience (Brief Overview)

- **Research Professional**\
  *IMAGINA Research Center, Universidad de los Andes \| Jun 2023 – Present*\
  Design and analyze studies on childhood, health, and violence prevention using **applied econometrics**, and build the indicator data behind public dashboards.

- **Policy Data Analyst and Consultant**\
  *Secretaría de Integración Social, Bogotá District Government \| Jun 2025 – Feb 2026*\
  Led a small team evaluating Bogotá's **district social policies**, and used AI tools and text analysis to review large volumes of policy documents and identify overlaps across programs.

- **Research Analyst**\
  *Vice-Presidency of Research & Creation, Universidad de los Andes \| Mar 2022 – May 2023*\
  Developed theories of change and cost-effectiveness analyses for **program evaluation and monitoring**, and harmonized data from the **Violence Against Children and Youth Surveys (VACS)** across 17 countries.

- **Research Assistant Intern**\
  *Alberto Lleras Camargo School of Government, Universidad de los Andes \| Aug 2021 – Feb 2022*\
  Synthesized evidence through **literature reviews** and qualitative data analysis on teenage pregnancy, child protection, and violence against children and women.
